63048-wanderers-of-the-wolf-moon.title: Wanderers Of The Wolf Moon
63048-wanderers-of-the-wolf-moon.creator: Unknown
63048-wanderers-of-the-wolf-moon.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "We hit a warp-eddy last night. We've been trapped in a vortex for more than eight hours. Lord only knows how many hundreds of thousands of miles we've been borne off our course. And now we've blasted into a super-ionized belt of atmospherics. Your radio signals are blanketed. You can't get signals in or out. We're a deaf-mute speck of metal being whirled headlong through space.

arxiv-2101-06514.title: Linguistically-Enriched and Context-Aware Zero-shot Slot Filling
arxiv-2101-06514.creator: A. B. Siddique, Fuad Jamour, Vagelis Hristidis
arxiv-2101-06514.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. B. Siddique, Fuad Jamour, Vagelis Hristidis. Slot filling is identifying contiguous spans of words in an utterance that correspond to certain parameters (i.e., slots) of a user request/query. Slot filling is one of the most important challenges in modern task-oriented dialog systems. Supervised learning approaches have proven effective at tackling this challenge, but they need a significant amount of labeled training data in a given domain. However, new domains (i.e., unseen in training) may emerge after deployment.

arxiv-2109-04804.title: Two-derivative deferred correction time discretization for the discontinuous Galerkin method
arxiv-2109-04804.creator: Jonas Zeifang, Jochen Schütz
arxiv-2109-04804.description: Abstract In this paper, we use an implicit two-derivative deferred correction time discretization approach and combine it with a spatial discretization of the discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method to solve (non-)linear PDEs. The resulting numerical method is high order accurate in space and time.

arxiv-2110-00143.title: Ultra-chaos: an insurmountable objective obstacle of reproducibility and replicability
arxiv-2110-00143.creator: Shijun Liao
arxiv-2110-00143.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, a new concept, i.e. ultra-chaos, is proposed for the first time. Unlike a normal-chaos, statistical properties such as the probability density functions (PDF) of an ultra-chaos are sensitive to tiny disturbances. We illustrate that ultra-chaos is widely existed and thus has general scientific meanings.

arxiv-2202-04422.title: Can a Single Population Account for the Discriminant Properties in Fast Radio Bursts?
arxiv-2202-04422.creator: Shu-Qing Zhong, Wen-Jin Xie, Can-Min Deng, Long Li, Zi-Gao Dai, Hai-Ming Zhang
arxiv-2202-04422.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shu-Qing Zhong, Wen-Jin Xie, Can-Min Deng, Long Li, Zi-Gao Dai, Hai-Ming Zhang. It is still a highly debated question as to whether fast radio bursts (FRBs) are classified into one or two populations. To probe this question, we perform a statistical analysis using the first Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment Fast Radio Burst (CHIME/FRB) catalog and identify a few discriminant properties between repeating and non-repeating FRBs such as the repetition rate, duration, bandwidth, spectral index, peak luminosity, and potential peak frequency.

arxiv-2209-07327.title: Search for pair production of vector-like quarks in leptonic final states in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2209-07327.description: Abstract A search is presented for vector-like \cmsSymbolFace ​ T \cmsSymbolFace{T} and \cmsSymbolFace ​ B \cmsSymbolFace{B} quark-antiquark pairs produced in proton-proton collisions at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV . Data were collected by the CMS experiment at the CERN LHC in 2016–2018, with an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv .

arxiv-2210-04975.title: MACARONS: A Modular and Open-Sourced Automation System for Vertical Farming
arxiv-2210-04975.creator: Vijja Wichitwechkarn, Charles Fox
arxiv-2210-04975.description: Abstract The Modular Automated Crop Array Online System (MACARONS) is an extensible, scalable, open hardware system for plant transport in automated horticulture systems such as vertical farms. It is specified to move trays of plants up to 1060mm × \times 630mm and 12.5kg at a rate of 100mm/s along the guide rails and 41.

arxiv-2601-03172.title: Feasibility study of the positronium lifetime imaging with the Biograph Vision Quadra and J-PET tomographs
arxiv-2601-03172.creator: SPSzymon Parzych, SNSzymon Niedźwiecki, EYBErmias Yitayew Beyene, NCNeha Chug, MCMaurizio Conti, CCCatalina Curceanu, ECEryk Czerwiński, MDManish Das, KVEKavya Valsan Eliyan, JHJakub Hajduga, SJSharareh Jalali, KKKrzysztof Kacprzak, TKTevfik Kaplanoglu, ŁKŁukasz Kapłon, KKKamila Kasperska, AKAleksan
arxiv-2601-03172.description: Abstract \parttitle Background After its first ex-vivo and in-vivo demonstration, Positronium Lifetime Imaging (PLI) has received considerable interest as a potential new diagnostic biomarker. High sensitivity Positron Emission Tomography (PET) systems are needed for PLI since it requires simultaneous registration of annihilation photons and prompt gamma.

arxiv-2601-04058.title: Minimum distance classification for nonlinear dynamical systems
arxiv-2601-04058.creator: Dominique Martinez
arxiv-2601-04058.description: Abstract We address the problem of classifying trajectory data generated by some nonlinear dynamics, where each class corresponds to a distinct dynamical system. We propose Dynafit, a kernel-based method for learning a distance metric between training trajectories and the underlying dynamics. New observations are assigned to the class with the most similar dynamics according to the learned metric.

pmc-11613861.title: Genetic kidney disease has a higher likelihood and cost of inpatient admissions compared to other aetiologies
pmc-11613861.creator: P. Marcin Sowa, Andrew J. Mallett, Luke B. Connelly
pmc-11613861.description: PurposeThere is increasing recognition of monogenic aetiologies for kidney disease. We sought to identify whether genetic kidney disease (GKD) has distinct hospitalization patterns compared to other forms of chronic kidney disease (CKD).MethodsHealth service utilization analysis was undertaken in a CKD cohort study across public hospital services in Queensland, Australia.

pmc-11642913.title: Does environmental information disclosure promote enterprise green technology innovation?
pmc-11642913.creator: Kun Zhang, Ji Li, Weigang Ma, Xingqi Wang, Syed Usman Qadri, Zhaoyang Zhao, Zhaoyang Zhao, Zhaoyang Zhao
pmc-11642913.description: Accelerating green technology innovation is essential for promoting economic transformation and achieving sustainable development. Environmental information disclosure (EID) at the city level, as a crucial component of the environmental governance system, provides new opportunities to drive enterprise green technology innovation.

pmc-12390055.title: Development of an Interactive Digital Human with Context-Sensitive Facial Expressions
pmc-12390055.creator: Fan Yang, Lei Fang, Rui Suo, Jing Zhang, Mincheol Whang, Wataru Sato
pmc-12390055.description: With the increasing complexity of human–computer interaction scenarios, conventional digital human facial expression systems show notable limitations in handling multi-emotion co-occurrence, dynamic expression, and semantic responsiveness. This paper proposes a digital human system framework that integrates multimodal emotion recognition and compound facial expression generation.

pmc-12528375.title: Image-based obstacle detection methods for the safe navigation of industrial unmanned aerial vehicles
pmc-12528375.creator: Liang Wang, Yin Shen, Haichao Li, Qunhong Shi, Songming Liu, Senyang Chen, Zeyu Chen, Ezzeddine Touti
pmc-12528375.description: Computer vision is becoming increasingly important for industrial unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to do real-time object and obstacle recognition while they are engaged in autonomous navigation. Variable texture features of objects, on the other hand, frequently lead to feature disappearance, which in turn reduces the accuracy of detection.

pmc-12564308.title: Is Digital Maxillary Model Scanning Reliable in Individuals with Unilateral Cleft Lip and Palate?
pmc-12564308.creator: Elif Merve Mavi, Ozge Uslu-Akcam, Mehmet Okan Akcam, Rodolfo Reda, Francesco Inchingolo
pmc-12564308.description: Objective: To evaluate the measurements made on digital scans of maxillary plaster models in comparison with those obtained directly with a digital caliper on plaster models obtained from individuals with unilateral cleft lip and palate. Methods: This study included 42 unilateral cleft lip and palate cases and a control group of 43 Angle Class I cases.

pmc-12729204.title: Identification and validation of ferroptosis-related key hub genes linking hypoxia and osteoporosis
pmc-12729204.creator: Yifan Gu, Qingsong Gu, Yiheng Li, Yuhu Chen, Yicong Wang, Jianqiao Li, Linhui Wang, Ziru Wang, Min Yang
pmc-12729204.description: BackgroundOsteoporosis (OP) is a prevalent progressive metabolic bone disease in the middle-aged and elderly population. Previous research has indicated that physiological or pathological hypoxia may disrupt bone metabolism, ultimately contributing to OP development. However, the specific pathophysiological mechanisms remain unknown. Ferroptosis is a novel iron-dependent non-apoptotic cell death pathway.

pmc-13221655.title: Inferring Patterns of Purifying, Positive, and Balancing Selection in the Coppery Titi Monkey (Plecturocebus cupreus) Utilizing a Well-Fit Evolutionary Baseline Model
pmc-13221655.creator: Vivak Soni, Cyril J Versoza, John W Terbot, Gabriella J Spatola, Karen L Bales, Susanne P Pfeifer, Jeffrey D Jensen, Toni Gossmann
pmc-13221655.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite the coppery titi monkey (Plecturocebus cupreus) being a model system for the study of neurodevelopment and behavior, the evolutionary forces shaping observed levels and patterns of genetic variation in the species have remained poorly studied. In order to illuminate the pervasive effects of purifying and background selection, we have fit a distribution of fitness effects of newly arising exonic mutations, utilizing patterns of polymorphism and divergence based on a recently published high-quality genome assembly.

pmc-13300723.title: Alcohol use disorder and clinical outcomes in atrial fibrillation: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-13300723.creator: M Vanhanen, J Jaakkola, K E J Airaksinen, O Halminen, J Putaala, V Langen, P Mustonen, J Haukka, J Hartikainen, A Luojus, M Niemi, M Linna, M Lehto, K Teppo
pmc-13300723.description: BackgroundAlcohol use disorders (AUD) are common and associated with significant multimorbidity, as well as increased risks of ischemic stroke and bleeding. In patients with atrial fibrillation (AF), stroke prevention is therefore crucial, but the impact of AUD on clinical outcomes—including ischaemic stroke, death, intracranial haemorrhage, and other major bleeding—remains unclear.
